description: This file contains an extension for the VoiceWakeOverlayController class, providing various methods to manage speech recognition overlay sessions, including starting, updating, presenting, dismissing, and auto-sending sessions, as well as handling user editing and levels.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Initializes and starts a new voice wake overlay session with provided parameters, setting relevant state and presenting the overlay.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current session state including token, source, text, and visibility.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the overlay with partial transcript data if the token matches and the session is not final.

methods.name: presentFinal
methods.description: Completes the overlay session with the final transcript, optionally scheduling auto-send after a delay, and updating forwarding state.

methods.name: userBeganEditing
methods.description: Marks the start of user editing, cancelling auto-send and updating the editing state.

methods.name: cancelEditingAndDismiss
methods.description: Cancels user editing and dismisses the overlay explicitly.

methods.name: updateText
methods.description: Updates the overlay with new text and refreshes the UI.

methods.name: beginSendUI
methods.description: Shows the sending UI state, plays a chime if specified, and dismisses the overlay after a short delay.

methods.name: requestSend
methods.description: Requests to send the current speech input via the session coordinator.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the overlay UI, animates removal, and resets state, with optional outcome-specific actions.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the visual level indicator if the token matches and enough time has passed since last update.

methods.name: guardToken
methods.description: Checks if the provided token matches the active token for the session.

methods.name: evaluateToken
methods.description: Static method to compare active and incoming tokens, used for validation.

methods.name: scheduleAutoSend
methods.description: Schedules an automatic send operation after a specified delay.

methods.name: makeAttributed
methods.description: Creates an attributed string from plain text with default styling.
